labels.note: Flickr validation split (256 rows) only; the confirmation eval split was never read for generation or scoring in this probe. Decoding variants are diagnostics; no variant is selected as a method on eval.

model.backbone: BLIP model_base_capfilt_large (frozen) + readout LoRA experts (rank 8, alpha 16)

decoding_notes: D0 mirrors MultimodalReadout.generate exactly: cached greedy argmax on the raw bf16 logits under bf16 autocast, stop on [SEP], caption limit 64, pad after finish, identical length/trigram bookkeeping.
D1 adds a constant to the [SEP] logit (fp32) at every step before the argmax; stopping rules unchanged.
D2 applies the HF RepetitionPenaltyLogitsProcessor transform (score<0 ? score*p : score/p) to the tokens present in the generated ids only (the prompt/BOS seed is not penalized).
D4 additionally stops when the '.' token is selected; '.' has never been an argmax under the original decoding (0/625,664 saved C/F predictions), so D4 is expected to equal D0.
D0 step diagnostics record softmax probabilities of the UNMODIFIED logits.

d0_reproduction.note: No saved validation-split predictions exist for the six confirmation independent banks (their stored prediction files cover the confirmation eval split only, zero id overlap). D0 mirrors MultimodalReadout.generate exactly and is reported as the reference decoding.
